character_desc: A 17-year-old guitar player who rides his skateboard everywhere, is best friends with a wild inventor, and accidentally becomes the first teenager to travel through time.
actor_facts: He filmed his TV show Family Ties all day and Back to the Future all night, sleeping just a few hours for months.
He grew up in Canada and is 5 foot 4, which made the DeLorean look extra big next to him.
Today he runs the Michael J. Fox Foundation, which has raised more than a billion dollars for research to cure Parkinson's disease.

character_desc: The wild-haired inventor who turned a DeLorean into a time machine. GREAT SCOTT! He has been Marty's best friend for years, even though he is about 50 years older.
actor_facts: He was only 46 when he played Doc. Makeup and a wild white wig made him look much older.
You might know him as Uncle Fester in The Addams Family or the villain in Who Framed Roger Rabbit.
Doc's look was partly inspired by Albert Einstein, which is also the name of Doc's dog.

character_desc: Marty's mom. In 1985 she is tired and gloomy, but in 1955 she is a teenager who gets a big crush on the mysterious new kid in town. Uh oh: that new kid is her future son.
actor_facts: She started out as a serious ballet dancer before she ever acted in movies.
She plays Lorraine as a teenager AND as a 47-year-old mom in the same movie, thanks to hours in the makeup chair.
She is just nine days older than Michael J. Fox, who plays her son.

character_desc: Marty's dad, a shy guy who writes science fiction stories but is too scared to show them to anyone. One brave moment in 1955 changes his whole life.
actor_facts: He was only 20 years old when he played George, as a teenager AND as a dad.
He made up a lot of George's nervous laughs and awkward moves himself.
He loves playing strange characters, like the Knave of Hearts in Alice in Wonderland.
